_comment: S4 deterministic inductor sensitivity, L x 0.936 (issue #244 AC 4c). Plain typical
sections, both tuning endpoints; f0/tuning-ratio shift vs the S0 baseline
(typical, L x 1.0) bounds gap G1 at the model's own measured error class.
No sampling: a deterministic bound, not a distribution.
engine_version 47 is the fail-closed post-run pin (issue #3041); the body carries selft=0
(the documented ngspice-47 VBIC self-heating deviation, run record 20261115-*).
